name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a manual light-mode toggle. High contrast improves visibility in low light, which matters for long sessions. The toggle respects user preference without cluttering the interface. Trade-off: some users may prefer light mode by default, but the override keeps everyone satisfied.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t preference—it’s habituation. Users won’t switch from dark mode once they’re used to it, even if light mode would be better for certain tasks. Instead, default to system preference but let users set a persistent override in settings. Settle it with a 2-week A/B test measuring session length and error rates in both modes.
